compatibility: Retains v3 bytes 0..225 except header packet_size=250/version=5. v5 is sent only for enabled heartbeat. Ordinary v3 and pile/pressure v4 remain byte-for-byte unchanged. v4 and v5 have the same length and must be dispatched by version. Both AtomS3 and StampC5 require v5-capable firmware for the heartbeat demo.

heartbeat_extension.source: MassState.heartbeat; fictional model state, not measured physiology.

canonical_json.legacy: v1/v2/v3/v4 omit mass.heartbeat; a preset name alone never synthesizes pulse state. v5 does not manufacture mass.demo pile/pressure values.

validation: Unchanged v3 semantic checks, except known v5 HeartbeatPulse event 8 is accepted only with WallNone. Reject disabled payloads, nonzero reserved byte, nonfinite/out-of-range phase or bpm, unknown event, wrong envelope/CRC. Three UNORM16 envelopes decode within [0,1].
